zh.title: 許哲誠
zh.subtitle: 全端開發／互動應用開發
zh.description: 新媒體藝術碩士，專注 Unity (C#) 客戶端架構、XR 互動開發與遊戲核心邏輯實作。具備軟體工程架構與全端開發整合實力，能串接前端互動、後端通訊與 3D 數位資產，並熟練運用現代開發工具提升效率，兼具美術視野與工程思維，致力打造結構穩定且運行流暢的互動體驗。

en.title: HSU, CHE-CHENG
en.subtitle: Fullstack Dev / Interactive App Dev
en.description: Master of New Media Arts specializing in Unity (C#) client architecture, XR interactive development, and core game logic implementation. Equipped with software engineering architecture and fullstack integration capabilities, bridging frontend interaction, backend communication, and 3D digital assets, proficient in modern development tools to boost productivity, combining artistic vision with engineering mindset to build architecturally sound and fluid interactive experiences.
